title: encrypt.rs ecdh_wrap_cek: AES-192-KW arm is dead code — no comment explains its presence
description: The match arm for kek_len == 24 in ecdh_wrap_cek() contains a complete AES-192-KW implementation that can never be reached from current callers. No comment says whether this is intentional dead code for future use or an oversight. A future reader doing dead-code analysis may be confused about whether AES-192 wrap is tested or supported. This pairs with the elegance issue (MIME-677.4) but is separately filed as readability because the lack of any explanatory comment is the main harm.
